prerequisites: the play costume is mislabeled Moon
actions: Ada notices the crossed-out label
Jo tries the tight tunic and says what she wants
consequences: the mismatch and Jo's wish are established
prose_obligations: Give Ada a practical wish to help
let Jo speak for herself
scenes.implementation_note: Executable opening consolidates the label, try-on, and first objection.

prerequisites: the Moon tunic is on the rail
actions: Jo tests its fit
consequences: the tunic is visibly unsuitable
prose_obligations: Do not imply Jo is wearing a fitting costume
scenes.implementation_note: Consolidated into opening; not a separate executable scene.

actions: Jo insists she was promised Storm
consequences: later help must preserve her choice
prose_obligations: Jo asks for an answer, not a replacement role
scenes.implementation_note: The dialogue and state change are consolidated into opening, not separately executable.

prerequisites: the school cape hangs on the cupboard hook
actions: Ada borrows the cape and tests a gust
consequences: Ada has temporary custody; its wind use is tested
prose_obligations: Keep school ownership distinct from borrowing

actions: Ada unfurls it as a wind cue
consequences: the prop has a later use beyond custody
prose_obligations: Show why the cape matters to the performance
scenes.implementation_note: The physical test is a second local action inside borrow_cape.

prerequisites: the teacher has not yet been asked
actions: Jo and Ada inspect the fit in the mirror; wipe it if dusty
consequences: Jo explicitly sees and names the mismatch
prose_obligations: A clean or dusty mirror changes the local action

prerequisites: the ribbon remains in the drawer
the teacher has not yet been asked
actions: Jo ties the ribbon to the cape clasp
consequences: the chosen detail travels with the cape and is used onstage
prose_obligations: Track the ribbon's location and return

prerequisites: the teacher has not been asked
actions: Ada asks Mrs Bell about the Storm costume
consequences: the answer depends on teacher availability and time
prose_obligations: An unavailable costume is not silently produced

prerequisites: Mrs Bell is present and there is time
actions: reserve the matching Storm coat
consequences: the right costume can be tried on
prose_obligations: Connect availability to a concrete parameter
scenes.implementation_note: The answer and reservation are one local consultation; there is no offstage coat retrieval in other cases.

actions: spend a minute waiting for an answer
consequences: time remaining decreases and may rule out the coat
prose_obligations: Do not treat a future costume as already delivered
scenes.implementation_note: The consultation records the time spent and its answer atomically.

actions: Ada and Jo inspect the tunic seam
consequences: available seam allowance and pins determine a safe alteration
prose_obligations: Do not force Jo into a pinched costume

prerequisites: seam allowance and pins are sufficient
actions: let out the seam and refit the tunic as Storm
consequences: Jo can wear a fitting, repurposed costume
prose_obligations: Consume the available pins
scenes.implementation_note: The repair is one guarded branch inside refit_costume.

prerequisites: no matching coat and no safe alteration
actions: Jo declines to be pinned into the tight tunic
consequences: she keeps the promised part but does not wear the unsuitable costume
prose_obligations: Treat refusal as a complete choice, not a failure of courage
scenes.implementation_note: Consolidated with seam assessment; this is an enacted local outcome, not an omitted scene effect.

actions: Jo chooses a fitted costume or an improvised Storm picture
consequences: the later rehearsal follows Jo's actual costume state
prose_obligations: Do not make a future plan sound like a completed performance
scenes.implementation_note: The choice is expressed by the outcome of refit_costume; it is not a separate scene.

actions: carry the cape to the rehearsal space
consequences: the next play occurs backstage
prose_obligations: Keep the cape in Ada's custody
scenes.implementation_note: Movement and rehearsal share one executable encounter.

actions: practice a gust or a silhouette
consequences: cape use and Jo's performance plan persist
prose_obligations: A fitting costume and an improvised look use different cues

actions: flash the ribbon on the cape at the performance cue
consequences: the borrowed prop carries Jo's chosen detail
prose_obligations: Only mention it if it was enacted
scenes.implementation_note: The cue is an action inside performance, conditional on the ribbon's actual location.

actions: take the Storm cue
consequences: Jo performs the promised role
prose_obligations: The scene is enacted before the ending
scenes.implementation_note: Entering and performing are local actions in the performance scene.

actions: Jo speaks Storm while Ada uses the cape
consequences: applause and the performed style are recorded
prose_obligations: A shadow or sail is not a fitting costume

actions: acknowledge Jo's choice and return borrowed objects
consequences: a fitted-costume or improvised-performance ending is complete
prose_obligations: Return the cape after it has been useful; resolve both endings
scenes.implementation_note: The two alternatives are separate executable endings; neither is a future conditional plan.
